next.reason: 1985: compilation is 'logically equivalent to processing all COPY statements prior to the processing of the resultant source program'. 2023: §2023:7.2.3.4 GR6 replaces the COPY statement by library text in the compilation group and §2023:7.2.3.4 GR8 modifies it 'during creation of the structured compilation group', the text-manipulation stage that precedes compilation. Same model. The 7.2.2.5 NOTE is non-normative.
